script.text: After defeating Rafael, Yugi finally met Dartz face-to-face.
You were expecting someone else? Well, due to the carelessness of my employees, I'm the only one left. You can't find good help these days.
Look. I want my company back, so can the small talk.
Is that so? Well guess what? We all want something. As for me, I want your souls.
For the last time, release our friends!
I mean, they've already been put to use. As we speak, their life energy supplies power to the most devastating creature that ever lived.
My 10,000 year-old collection is almost complete. Once I get yours, my beast can rise.
Hold on! You've been collecting souls for all those years!? Do you know how many lives you've destroyed!?
So some of these people lived in the past?
Now you're catching on. Ever since the great Leviathan was laid to rest, I've been gathering the energy necessary to fuel its rebirth!
Come on, you expect us to believe that junk?
Ye of little faith. Just duel me and I promise I'll make a believer out of you. For when you lose, there will be no denying my power!
